name: roll peroneal (single leg) side lying on floor
description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer lower leg. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under the outer lower leg, other foot behind for support.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.
